correctness.rationale: Forced consecutive blocks are full components, so different occurrences have disjoint supports. Each specified orientation on a four-site block gives a unique reinsertion into each unrestricted pair of remaining matchings. Laying out labeled intervals of lengths 2 and 4 and distributing the remaining vertices in gaps gives (2n-4)(2n-5) mixed placements, exactly the displayed expression; the two equal-length counts follow by the same argument. Exact rational algebra (python3 /workspace/evidence/5_covariances.py) reproduced both finite covariance formulas, positive shifted numerators at n=4+x, and all covariance and concentration limits. Independently switching each four-site block preserves outside arcs, all supports, and the uniform measure. Thus conditioning on information invariant under every such switch gives independent fair signs, not unconditional independence of the two counts. Since Y_n/n tends to 1/64 in L^2, the conditional characteristic function of D_n/sqrt(n) tends boundedly in probability to exp(-s^2/128). Multiplying by the short-loop phase and using Janson–Thévenin Eq. (3.8) establishes exactly the independent signed bivariate limit; it does not require a full three-dimensional CLT. The frozen finite checker was inspected, not executed.
